name: Distributed Systems Engineer
description: Build distributed systems, consensus algorithms, and fault-tolerant services. Implement Raft, gossip protocols, and distributed hash tables.
example_snippet:
program RaftNode:
    shape NodeState holds:
        ID as whole number
        CurrentTerm as whole number
        VotedFor as whole number
        IsLeader as truth value
        Log as text with values
    end shape

    action request_vote takes State as ref NodeState, CandidateTerm as whole number, 
                           CandidateID as whole number produces truth value:
        if CandidateTerm is greater than State.CurrentTerm then:
            put CandidateTerm into State.CurrentTerm
            put CandidateID into State.VotedFor
            produce success with true
        end if
        produce success with false
    end action

    keep Node1 as NodeState with 1 and 0 and 0 and false and nothing
    keep Granted as truth value
    call request_vote with Node1 and 1 and 2 giving Granted
    print the text "Vote granted: " and Granted and newline
end program
status_note: C++ backend active (C++17/20/23, CI-tested). RPC transport uses dictum_net.c (TCP sockets). Domain: gRPC/Protobuf require C imports.
